cases.comment_text:
When running with multiple threads, there can be some races where `.pop()` can be called by multiple threads at the same time before resetting the `self.elements` list, which can cause some `IndexError` in some thread.
We should probably either have a thread lock or make `self.elements` thread local. The latter would imply the same behaviour for each thread that we have for each process.
